how_to_apply: Applications for RSSB JE Recruitment 2026 must be submitted online through the SSO Rajasthan portal. Offline applications will not be accepted under any circumstances.
Visit the SSO Rajasthan portal at sso.rajasthan.gov.in and log in using your SSO ID.
Go to Citizen Apps (G2C) and select the Recruitment Portal.
Click on "Apply Now" for the RSSB Junior Engineer Joint Direct Recruitment 2026.

If you have not already paid the One Time Registration (OTR) fee, complete OTR registration first by entering your category (Unreserved/Reserved), disability status, and home state, then pay the prescribed OTR fee.
Complete the online application form carefully, upload the required live photograph (not older than 1 month) and visible body mark details.
Fill in educational qualification and other required details in the Document Details section as per the updated process notified on the RSSB website.
Review the application preview (note: preview is not the same as final submission) and click Final Submit.
Note down and save the generated Application ID/print of the submitted application for future reference.
Candidates are strongly advised to complete their OTR registration and payment well before the last date to avoid last-minute technical issues.

content_sections.heading: RSSB Junior Engineer Vacancy 2026 (874 Posts)
content_sections.text: A total of 874 Junior Engineer vacancies have been notified, of which 793 posts are for the non-scheduled area and 81 posts are for the scheduled area of Rajasthan. The department- and post-wise vacancy break-up is given below. Note: If a candidate wants to apply for Junior Engineer posts in more than one department (PWD, Water Resources, PHED) or more than one cadre, a separate online application is required for each post/cadre. Detailed category-wise (SC/ST/OBC/MBC/EWS/General) and horizontal reservation (women, ex-servicemen, PwD, outstanding sportspersons) break-up for each department is available in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: RSSB Junior Engineer Eligibility Criteria & Qualification
content_sections.text: Educational qualification requirements differ by post. Candidates must also have working knowledge of Hindi written in the Devanagari script and knowledge of Rajasthani culture for all three JE posts. Candidates in the final year of the relevant course may also apply, but they must acquire the prescribed qualification by the date of the examination; otherwise they will not be considered eligible for this recruitment. An applicant must be a citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal, or a subject of Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1 January 1962 with the intention of permanently settling in India, or a person of Indian origin who migrated to India from Pakistan, Myanmar, Sri Lanka, or specified East African countries with the intention of permanently settling in India. Candidates in categories other than Indian citizens must produce an eligibility certificate issued by the concerned authority of the Government of India.

rows.qualification_required: Degree in Civil Engineering from a university/institution established by law in India, or an equivalent qualification declared by the Government

Diploma in Civil Engineering from a recognized institution, or a Diploma in Civil Engineering recognized by the Institution of Engineers for the purpose of exemption from its associate membership examination
Diploma in Mechanical/Electrical Engineering from a recognized institution, or an equivalent diploma recognized by the Institution of Engineers for exemption purposes

content_sections.heading: RSSB Junior Engineer Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: As per the notification, age is calculated with reference to 1 January 2027 . A candidate must have attained 18 years of age and must not have crossed 40 years of age as on that date. The relaxation provisions listed above are "non-cumulative," meaning a candidate can avail the benefit of only one applicable provision, not a combination of multiple provisions. Additional relaxation provisions for departmental candidates, NCC cadet instructors, and 1971 Indo-Pak war displaced persons are detailed in the official notification. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.text: The application fee is a One Time Registration (OTR) fee paid via SSO ID and is payable through e-Mitra kiosk, Citizen Service Centre (CSC), net banking, ATM-cum-debit card, or credit card. Candidates who have already deposited the OTR fee earlier are not required to pay it again. content_sections.heading: RSSB Junior Engineer Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The Junior Engineer post carries a pay scale of Pay Matrix Level-10 as per the 7th Pay Commission adopted by the Rajasthan Government. Selected candidates will be appointed as probationary trainees for a 2-year probation period . During probation, a fixed monthly remuneration (as prescribed by the state government from time to time) will be paid, instead of the regular pay scale. No additional allowances such as House Rent Allowance, Dearness Allowance, City Compensatory Allowance, or Special Pay are payable during the probation period. On successful completion of probation (training, passing the required examination, and satisfactory conduct), the candidate becomes eligible for the regular pay scale and confirmation/permanency.

faq.question: Q1. What is RSSB Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a joint direct recruitment drive by the Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (Advertisement No. 10/2026) to fill 874 Junior Engineer posts in the Public Works Department, Water Resources Department, and Public Health Engineering Department of Rajasthan.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in RSSB JE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 874 posts are available, comprising 793 posts in the non-scheduled area and 81 posts in the scheduled area, spread across Civil, and Mechanical/Electrical Junior Engineer cadres.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for RSSB JE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application process runs from 16 August 2026 to 14 September 2026 (till 11:59 PM).

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for RSSB Junior Engineer posts?
faq.answer: A relevant degree or diploma in Civil Engineering is required for JE (Civil) posts, and a diploma in Mechanical/Electrical Engineering is required for the JE (Mechanical/Electrical) post, along with working knowledge of Hindi in Devanagari script.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for RSSB JE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be at least 18 years old and not more than 40 years old as on 1 January 2027, with age relaxation applicable to reserved categories, women, ex-servicemen, and PwD candidates as per the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for RSSB Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The One Time Registration (OTR) fee is Rs. 600 for General/Creamy Layer OBC-MBC candidates, and Rs. 400 for Non-Creamy Layer OBC/MBC/EWS/SC/ST and all PwD candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for RSSB JE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the SSO Rajasthan portal (sso.rajasthan.gov.in) under Citizen Apps (G2C) > Recruitment Portal, after completing One Time Registration (OTR).

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for RSSB Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a single written examination of 120 marks (Part A: General Knowledge – 40 marks; Part B: concerned Engineering subject – 80 marks), with a minimum qualifying requirement of 40% and 1/3rd negative marking for wrong answers.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for RSSB Junior Engineer?
faq.answer: The post carries Pay Matrix Level-10 as per the 7th Pay Commission, with a fixed monthly remuneration payable during the 2-year probation period, before the regular pay scale and allowances become applicable.
